## Projects and research development

### Lead and emerging independent development

**TROPECO-OMICS · 2026 · DFG–Universidad de Antioquia bilateral proposal**  
**Status:** Under evaluation.  
**Role:** German-side applicant and conceptual lead.

Developed the project and emerging Hi-SGH framework, integrating transcriptomics, proteomics, microbiome analysis and physiology to examine transitions from adaptive compensation toward resilience loss across real-world chemical-stress gradients.

### Funded research participation

**MixTOX · Swedish Research Council FORMAS · 2025–present**  
Researcher.

**CRC 1439 RESIST · DFG · 2021–2024**  
Doctoral researcher contributing research on freshwater fish responses to multiple stressors.

**TAPAS · EU Horizon 2020 · 2016–2018**  
MSc researcher contributing to research on aquaculture impacts in marine systems.

### Research directions

Research directions include biological resilience under environmental stress; fish ecophysiology and welfare; environmental molecular monitoring and field ecotoxicology; aquatic holobionts and microbiomes; non-model eco-omics; and reproducible environmental biology.
